note: 2026-10-18 - 'What Caused America's Health Crisis?' (Rumble v5isd6d). Weekly agent, WB health lane.

clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says something shifted in American food around 1967: frozen dinners took over the freezer aisle, and processed meals became the everyday norm almost overnight.

His own story: a full blood panel, every test from head to toe. The doctor said 99% of the results weren't just acceptable, they were optimal, the kind you would expect from someone decades younger.

Kevin's take: it isn't luck, it's what and how you eat every day.

Next grocery run, count how many items in your cart were packaged before you could just reheat them, and swap one for something closer to how it grew.
